title: Value Compass Benchmarks: A Comprehensive, Generative and Self-Evolving Platform for LLMs’ Value Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the correlation between an LLM's multi-dimensional value vectors (generated via value-evoking test items) and culturally specific human value priorities collected from large-scale social surveys across different countries (e.g., UK, China, US).

Generative self-evolving evaluation paradigm that automatically synthesizes open-ended, value-evoking test items, utilizing a robust value recognizer (CLAVE) to score LLM responses against pluralistic systems like the Schwartz Theory of Basic Values and Moral Foundation Theory.
Incorporating a three-level hierarchical safety taxonomy comprising 6 domains (including representation & toxicity harms) and 66 sub-categories, evaluated dynamically through co-evolving test items.
